user_prompt: We need to establish a comprehensive procurement and delivery workflow that coordinates vendor assessment, augments customer purchases with enriched data, validates regulatory requirements, and manages incoming stock alongside staff and resource allocation. Can you design this end-to-end supply chain orchestration to ensure seamless coordination across all these interconnected operations?
